name: plist_read
description: Read an XML or binary property list and return it as JSON, with Apple date values converted to ISO 8601 UTC and binary blobs represented with size, hash and a bounded preview. Reads one file or every plist under a directory.

path.description: A .plist file, or a directory to walk

key.description: Return only this top-level key, or a dotted path into the structure

max_blob.description: Bytes of a binary value to include, base64 (default 64)

limit.description: Maximum files returned inline when out_file is set (default 200); every parsed file is written to out_file

out_file.description: Optional JSONL path for every parsed plist; when absent every parsed file is returned inline
